title: Building a district hospital through partnership
body: A state government plans a new district hospital. It signs a contract with a private construction firm, MedBuild Ltd., to design and build the hospital within two years. The hospital will be financed and owned by the state government, and the state health department will run it after completion, appointing its own doctors and staff. If the design is faulty or construction is delayed, MedBuild Ltd. must bear the extra cost under the contract. Some residents near the site have objected that the construction may harm a small wetland, and the firm and the government disagree over who should pay for protective measures. The government also notes that very few private financiers showed interest in funding the project.
